Sikkim launches AI-powered learning in 71 government schools

Sikkim has launched the 'AI-FunZone' program in 71 government schools, aiming to provide personalized learning experiences for students. Teachers will lead classes with the support of artificial intelligence, utilizing real-time dashboards to monitor student progress. The initiative focuses on integrating AI into the educational system.
